changes_description: xswap fault readahead with adjacency gate (c1, commit 31eb4618): xswap_fault_readahead takes the readahead path for order-0 non-shmem faults with page_cluster>0 adjacent to the VMA last fault; both readahead paths filter xswap neighbours per entry (xswap_readahead_wanted) instead of skipping the device. Expect swapin-zram-64k swapin_seq.mean_ns down, swapin_rand.mean_ns ~unchanged; swap_ra and swap_ra_hit up, pgmajfault down.
